events.title: «NOCLIP» - HOTFIX v4
events.summary: Hello, researcher!This is another hotfix addressing a few bugs.There aren't many, but they will improve your gameplay in the prologue.Lighting has been fixed.Collision detection has also been improved; previously, you could walk right through certain triggers.More objectives have been added to help you navigate the prologue.That's all! Thank you for your feedback!

events.title: «NOCLIP» - HOTFIX v3

Improvements Objective tracker and notifications are larger and easier to read. In-world PC: scrollbar reskinned, text size and readability improved. No-run zone effects ramped up. events.title: Backrooms: Impending Doom - Demo Available Now
events.summary: THE DEMO IS HERE The wait is over. Backrooms: Impending Doom Demo is now available on Steam - completely free. Step into the Backrooms and experience the beginning of our journey. ABOUT THE DEMO You find yourself somewhere you shouldn't be. A maze of empty or not so rooms, familiar yet deeply unsettling. There is no clear explanation for where you are or how you got there.
